reason: I'd self-host it the week it hits HN and play with it on our internal repos, but I won't pay $99 for a pre-alpha one-person project, and I can't point unattended agents at client code without client sign-off anyway.
objection: Our clients may not allow AI agents on their code, let alone agents running alone overnight, and a pre-alpha tool from one developer is hard to defend to them.
would_change_my_mind: A client actually approving unattended agent runs on their repo, plus the project being past pre-alpha with a few other agencies using it.
